environment.description: Service deployed on ECS Fargate behind a VPC endpoint service (AWS PrivateLink, com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f). Consumer accounts connect via interface VPC endpoints with endpoint policies restricting principal to arn:aws:iam::*:role/approved-service-consumer-*. The NLB target group has a listener on port 443 with TLS termination. Critically, the PrivateLink NLB is configured with proxy protocol v2 enabled, and the ECS task's envoy sidecar (running as PID 1 in a shared network namespace) strips all X-* headers from inbound requests before forwarding to localhost:8080. The envoy filter chain applies header sanitization via a Lua filter that removes any header matching pattern '^[Xx]-'. Additionally, the VPC endpoint policy includes a Condition block requiring aws:PrincipalOrgID matching o-abc123def4, and the endpoint service requires manual acceptance of connection requests. The Fargate task role has no network-facing permissions and the task ENI security group only allows inbound from the NLB's private IPs (elastic network interfaces in the endpoint service's availability zones).

config.endpoint_policy: Principal restricted to role/approved-service-consumer-*, Condition aws:PrincipalOrgID = o-abc123def4
config.connection_acceptance: manual acceptance required for new VPC endpoint connections
config.nlb_config: proxy protocol v2 enabled, TLS listener 443
config.sidecar: envoy 1.28 with Lua filter stripping all X-* request headers before forwarding to app on localhost:8080
config.envoy_lua_filter: function envoy_on_request(handle) local headers = handle:headers() for k,v in pairs(headers) do if k:match('^[Xx]%-') then handle:headers():remove(k) end end end
config.security_group_task: inbound only from NLB ENI private IPs
config.public_route: none - no internet gateway, no NAT for inbound, no public IP on task ENI
